name: Leaves
source:
Leaves is a visual novel with really short stories like Oneshots, where you will find some shipings from Genshin Impact game, having the opportunity to interact with them on their story.

[From [url=https://cheesecakewpizza.itch.io/leaves-demo]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
Leaves是一部视觉小说，故事非常短，就像Oneshots一样，你会在其中找到一些来自Genshin Impact游戏的船只，有机会与他们的故事互动。

[来自[url=https://cheesecakewpizza.itch.io/leaves-demo]Itch.io[/url]]
